fee_notes: Two royalty programs: Program A (new/conversion franchisees) = 5% of Gross Revenue with $6,250/associate/year cap; Program B (existing franchisees pre-Jan 9 2019) = 6% of Gross Revenue with same $6,250 cap. Property Management Fee = 1.5% of Gross Revenue from property management. BMF Program A = 1% up to $1,250/associate threshold then 0.5%; BMF Program B = 1.5% up to $4M then 0.5%.
raw_excerpt: PROGRAM A: 5% of "Gross Revenue"...PROGRAM B: 6% of "Gross Revenue"
